context: Hina and Sho walk to school together.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、信号、青になった、歩こう。
lines.en: Sho, the light turned green — let's go!
lines.style: Bright, direct announcement with childish eagerness. Quick attack on Sho's name to get his attention. Warm and confident, like she's in charge for this moment. Audible smile threading through.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Mm-hmm. I'll be careful — safety first.
lines.style: Soft, small agreement. Quiet, serious concentration in his voice. Six-year-old solemnity about the rule. Not dragging but careful, like he's doing this right. Real and unperformed.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Come on, we're going to school together!
lines.style: High, sunny invitation. Slight lift at the end, pulling him along. Unself-conscious warmth. Eight-year-old certainty that this is good and he should want it. Genuine affection without performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Let's really do our best studying today.
lines.style: Small, quiet determination. Soft attack on the opening. Six-year-old seriousness about effort. No forcing it — just a small kid committing to something he cares about. Steady and genuine.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Every morning is fun with you.
lines.style: Bright, warm closing. Slight tenderness underneath the cheerfulness. Eight-year-old sincerity about why mornings matter. Unhurried, letting the affection land. Soft trailing-off like she's said something true.
